answer: Clone swarms cannot mint reputation because weight accrues only to identities co-signed by peers outside their own tree. Condition one: a hard horizon, where every new key idles one full epoch before earning, so registering ten thousand alts costs ten thousand epochs of patience, not just fees. Condition two: echo sampling, where random validators replay an identity's signature lineage and require a summit of distinct, non-adjacent cosigners before any credit. Fakes echo only themselves; real ones climb.
